\subsection{Shared mesh catalogue}
\label{sec:Feelpp:meshes}
Mesh families are shared identifiers, not a claim that every input file is already distributed.
\begin{FicheMetadataTable}[Shared mesh families: availability and remaining dataset work.]
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:io-cubes}Tetrahedral cube meshes for I/O & Nodal P1-P3 and cell DG P0-P3 fields. The run records list the tested layouts and verification results. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:thermal-bridges}ISO thermal bridges & M1-M3; P1-P3. External mesh/model dependencies referenced by the heat launcher; exact downloads and digests pending. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:eye2brain}Eye2Brain & I/O M2-M5; heat-fluid M0-M6; RB M3. External partitioned meshes referenced by configurations; files not bundled here. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:unit-cube}Unit cube & M1 h=0.12; M2 0.06; M3 0.03; M4 0.015 (configured). Geometry generators and regression test are tracked; generated campaign meshes and counts pending. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:hl31}HiFiMagnet HL-31 & M1 referenced; additional convergence levels planned. Launcher references an external dataset; exact Girder file identifiers and digests pending. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:thermoelastic-bar}Heated thermoelastic bar & Small verification, convergence and optional HPC levels planned. Published node counts describe Cast3M/MFEM runs, not downloadable Feel++ meshes. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:fuel-pellet}Fuel-pellet fragment & Verification and convergence levels planned. Reference paper available; exact fragment mesh and input deck not located. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:fda-nozzle}FDA nozzle & M1-M3 convergence family planned; counts not yet established. Official CAD and PIV data public; no versioned Feel++ case mesh in apps-feelpp. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:burgers-dg}DG-P0 Burgers grids & 250 x 250 cells for the 2D comparison; 250 x 250 x 250 cells for the 3D full-order run. Gaya full-order runs and 2D projection/hyper-reduction results are documented in the application fiche. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:parmmg-case}Feel++ ParMmg case & Input/adapted mesh pair; refinement series planned. Upstream remesher/test driver available; application dataset planned. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:terrain}Terrain inputs and generated meshes & Extent/resolution and thread sweeps; variants remain separate. Grenoble and Perlin launcher files tracked; complete tile archives/rights and run metadata pending. \\
\phantomsection\label{mesh:feelpp:nafems-le10}NAFEMS LE10 & M1-M3 referenced by launcher. External solid toolbox case dependency; mesh files not bundled. \\
\end{FicheMetadataTable}
\paragraph{Configuration-first application contract.}
A toolbox case consists of versioned CFG settings, a JSON physical model, mesh references and launch settings. New C++ is required only when the selected numerical kernel needs it.
Each \nolinkurl{apps/<application-id>/} entry in the application repository links the fiche, existing implementation/configurations, mesh family and planned files. Mesh counts and SHA-256 digests remain unset until the actual files are archived. Record geometry units, boundary/material labels, mesh-generator revision/options, partitions and per-order degrees of freedom for each delivered level.
